coverage_notes:
PRIMARY SOURCE: the Clemson athletics staff directory as archived by the Wayback Machine on Dec. 11, 2018 (https://web.archive.org/web/20181211232455/http://clemsontigers.com/staff-directory) — the last capture before the Jan. 7, 2019 CFP National Championship, so it reflects the staff as constituted at the title game. It renders every department on one page; I pulled the "Football" section in full plus every football-designated person in Strength & Conditioning, Sports Medicine, Equipment Services, Communications, Compliance Services and Student-Athlete Enrichment Services (academics).

QUOTE-MATCHING CAVEAT (important): on that directory page each person's name and title live in ADJACENT <td> cells of the same table row, so no contiguous "Name — Title" string exists in the page text. Every quote I supply is therefore the person's title cell copied verbatim (contiguous, exact, ampersands are literal "&" in the source, not entities), and each source note names the person whose row it belongs to. Titles that repeat elsewhere on the page (e.g. "Head Coach", "Administrative Assistant") are flagged in the note with the section heading needed to disambiguate. Three people (Swinney, Alley, Grisham/Goodwin) also carry a second source with a contiguous prose quote naming them.

FOUND OUTSIDE THE DIRECTORY: the directory omits pure analyst/GA roles. I added three, each from a bio page with contiguous prose: Wes Goodwin (senior defensive assistant, 2018-21), Tyler Grisham (offensive analyst, 2016-19), and Zac Alley (graduate assistant, 2015-18). Wikipedia's 2018 team page corroborates the on-field staff and Alley.

KNOWN GAPS / THINGS I COULD NOT DOCUMENT:
1. Andrew Warwick appears as "Assistant for Defensive Analysis & Reserach Development" [sic] in the July 6, 2018 capture of the same directory but is ABSENT from the Dec. 11, 2018 capture. I could not determine whether he departed, was retitled, or was simply dropped from the listing, so I excluded him rather than guess. He is a real 2018-calendar-year staffer if you want to chase him further.
2. Clemson almost certainly carried more graduate assistants than the one (Alley) I could source. GA rosters are not in the directory and I found no published 2018 GA list. Treat the gradasst count as a floor.
3. Additional offensive/defensive analysts beyond Goodwin, Grisham, Richardson, Aiken, Chavis and McCombs may exist and are undocumented here.
4. Team physicians (Dr. Len Reeves, Dr. Larry Bowman, Dr. Steven L. Martin, Dr. Tenley Murphy) are listed department-wide with no sport designation, so I excluded them rather than assert football assignment. The three athletic trainers I included are explicitly tagged "- Football".
5. The 208-page 2018 Clemson media guide (issuu.com/clemsontigers) would likely close gaps 1-3, but it is a page-image PDF whose text cannot be copied faithfully for mechanical matching, so I did not source from it.
6. No mid-season arrivals or departures among the people listed below were documented; all appear in the Dec. 11, 2018 capture or in bios that explicitly span the 2018 season. No midseason_note was warranted for anyone.
